LanguageData.CC_Settings_BondsTakeTime_Tip: A friendship needs two people to know each other as well as like each other. They come to know each other from time actually spent side by side (working near each other, meals, recreation), talks and what they go through together. New colonists start as strangers, so friendships take weeks; close friends who stop seeing each other slowly drift apart.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_BondsTakeTime: New colonists start as strangers; friends drift apart when they stop seeing each other.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ChemistryLimits: How two get on sets limits
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ChemistryLimits_Tip: How two colonists get on comes from the game's own compatibility between them, their faiths, the views they hold, passions they share and their temper (a kind soul gets on with most people, an abrasive one with few). Two who don't click stay friendly colleagues however many talks they have; two who get on easily warm to each other quickly. Hovering a colonist in the Social tab says how a pair gets on and why.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_ChemistryLimits: Two who don't click stay friendly colleagues; two who click warm quickly.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ComradesByDanger_Tip: Only colonists who fought near each other in a fight become comrades, and more so when one carried the other out, tended them under fire or stood over them while they were down. Every fight together counts in full. Comradeship fades in long quiet spells, down to what a long history of fighting together leaves. Rivals who fight side by side ease off.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_ComradesByDanger: Comrades from fighting near each other, fading in quiet spells.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DeedsRemembered: What people do to each other is remembered
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DeedsRemembered_Tip: Harm done (a social fight, a blow in a rage, a shot in a fight), cross words, a botched operation, an affair and envy of a much better room or title start grudges, each with its cause. A grudge holds a few days and then fades slowly unless it is renewed. Someone carried out of a fight, tended under fire or nursed through an illness is grateful to whoever did it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_DeedsRemembered: Grudges with their causes, and gratitude for a rescue or a doctor's care.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SeatFeelings: A council seat lost is felt
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SeatFeelings_Tip: Whoever stood for a seat and saw someone else win it thinks less of the winner, the more the more they wanted it: holding the seat before, a life goal of a seat on the council, a vain or jealous nature, a campaign of their own. Losing to the same person again, or a winner who gloats, can start a rivalry. Moving to another seat on the council is only a mood.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_SeatFeelings: Losers of a seat think less of the winner, as much as they wanted it.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_LoveFeelings_Tip: A partner who minds it is jealous when their partner grows close to someone else. Things are awkward for a while between two after one turned the other down or they broke up. Someone turned down or left who then sees their beloved take up with another holds it against the new partner. The game's own romance is left as it is.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_LoveFeelings: Jealousy, awkward spells, and losing out to someone else.
